name: voz-effects-only
note: Effects-only launch film, from earshot's minimal preset. Recorded sounds (click, ding, page turn) live in audio/recorded; see docs/research/launch-video-sound-map.md.

pop.note: element pop-in: rows, cards, pills arriving (80-150 Hz thump + tick, lands 25-40 ms after)

land.note: a bigger element arriving: the app icon

whoosh.long.note: the one section change into the hook: a low designed swell, peak on the cut

key.note: designed key ticks, a new take per key

key.return.note: the last key of a typed message
